description: This PHP class, MigrationHelper, provides utility methods for handling database migration logging in the OrangeHRM system. It manages starting and finishing migration logs, creating the migration log table if it doesn't exist, and interacts with the database using Doctrine DBAL. The class also utilizes auxiliary services like DateTimeHelperService and SchemaHelper.

classes.name: MigrationHelper
classes.description: A utility class for managing database migration logs, including starting and finishing migration entries, creating log table if absent, and interacting with database version info.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes MigrationHelper with an optional database connection.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the current database connection, either the injected one or a default.

methods.name: getSchemaHelper
methods.description: Returns an instance of SchemaHelper, creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: logMigrationStarted
methods.description: Logs the start of a migration by creating a new record in ohrm_migration_log, creating the table if necessary.

methods.name: logMigrationFinished
methods.description: Updates the existing migration log record to mark the migration as finished.
